authentication: changes need an API token (see 'partstrack token add') in the header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'

changes.DELETE /api/parts/<id>: delete a part with its stock, history and attachments
changes.PATCH /api/locations/<id>: name, description, parent (a path, or null for the top level)
changes.PATCH /api/parts/<id>: change the fields given; tags and attributes replace all; min_quantity null removes it
changes.POST /api/locations: add a location: path (parents are created too), description
changes.POST /api/parts: add a part: name (required), description, manufacturer, mpn, category, package, notes, tags (list), attributes (object), min_quantity, stock (list of {location, quantity})
changes.POST /api/parts/<id>/attachments: attach a link as JSON: url, kind (datasheet, image, other; default: from the name), download (default true: store a copy of a file a link points to); or upload a file as multipart/form-data: file, kind
changes.POST /api/parts/<id>/attachments/<id>/do: store a copy of the file a link points to
changes.POST /api/parts/<id>/move: to, and from with an optional quantity (default: all there); without from, all stock moves; note
changes.POST /api/parts/<id>/stock: location and either quantity (the new amount there) or delta (added or, if negative, taken); note

endpoints./api/history: stock changes, newest first; filters: part (id), location, limit (default 50, 0 for all)
endpoints./api/locations: all locations, parents before their children
endpoints./api/parts: parts; filters: q (search, e.g. 'smd resistance>=10k'), tag, location, category, low
endpoints./api/snapshot: the database and attachments as .tar.gz, for the desktop app's read-only copies
endpoints./api/tags: tags with the number of parts that have them
endpoints./api/token: checks the API token sent (401 if it isn't valid) and whether changes can be saved
